titulo: The Dover Demon Copied My Friend's Voice | Cryptid Horror #Shorts
titulo_pt: O Dover Demon copiou a voz do meu amigo
resumo_pt: Três amigos encontram uma criatura de olhos enormes numa ponte em Massachusetts. Ela repete a voz deles um segundo depois. Na última noite, a voz do narrador passa a ser a da criatura.
descricao:
Three friends. One bridge. A creature that copies your voice.

Follow @VeilFrequency for a new horror story every day. Based on American folklore. Images are AI-generated.

scenes.text: Three of us went to the old bridge in Dover, Massachusetts.
scenes.pt: Três de nós fomos à ponte antiga em Dover, Massachusetts.

scenes.text: Something was sitting on the railing.

scenes.text: Then my friend said, 'Get out of here.'

scenes.text: A second later, it said it too.

scenes.text: I heard my own voice in the hallway.

scenes.text: It was walking behind me, copying me.

scenes.text: I'm writing this with my own hand.

scenes.text: I still hear it at night.
